column1: # Lonely Mountains: Downhill 1.0.5 (base v0), Unity 2018.4.14f1 IL2CPP / FMOD, SDK 9.3.1.
# Tested 2026-11-05 with nx2android v0.3.0 on Retroid Pocket 6, Android 13,
# Launch, controller input and downhill gameplay work at approximately 60 fps.
# The tested conversion enabled multithread replay; preserve that option here.
# Stock-driver behavior has not been compared. No custom driver is bundled or selected by this profile.
# Known issues: a brief visual glitch between rider preparation and GO on the first race;
# occasional one-frame black/white flashes. No crash observed in the short sessions.
# Runtime reports CPU reads overlapping GPU writes not known complete; their relation to the
# visual glitches is unproven, and the warnings also occur before the 120 Hz experiment.
# Save/reload, a full playthrough and all DLC courses have not been systematically verified.
# A separate opt-in 120 Hz experiment (DM_PRESENT_HZ=120, DM_ADAPTIVE_FPS=0) was reported
# playable at normal speed, with recorded frame medians near 8.3 ms. It is not the default:
# long-term thermals, precise simulation timing and all routes remain unverified.
